verdict.rationale: A changelog entry confirms PlanetScale has configurable Vitess read-only regions and lists the regions available to a database, which points to a first-party way to put read replicas in other regions. Separate docs show reads can be routed to replicas to offload the primary, but nothing ties replicas to geographic placement or latency. missing for 10: first-party docs on creating and placing read-only regions, Postgres cross-region replica support, guidance on routing reads to the nearest region, independent or hands-on evidence of lower worldwide read latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide

citations.quote: You can now list the regions available to a database, and list configured Vitess read-only regions for the database's default branch.
They provide a way to reduce load on your primary instance by allowing you to read from a replica.
Append `|replica` to the end of your username for the branch you want to target
